Thanks again for yesterday's kick-off. A couple of billing items the AP team asked me to confirm before we turn on the pilot billing:

- Who will be the "invoice sender" on the PDF/metadata? Their policy requires either the vendor legal name on the PDF header or a portal-issued invoice with matching metadata.

- Credit memos / proration: if our usage is prorated after the invoice, what is the process for issuing credit memos? Do you support consolidated monthly credit memos or only individual CMs per invoice?

We'd prefer the portal for auditability, but AP still wants a PDF copy to finance@brightwood.ai for their records. Also, any SFTP or E-invoice options for credit memo delivery would be ideal.

Subject: Re: Billing logistics for Redwood pilot (Invoice sender, PO & credits)

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. Putting options and recommended defaults below so AP can pick what fits their control environment.

1) Invoice sender / visibility
- Option A (recommended for audit trails): Redwood issues the invoice from "Redwood Inference, Inc." via the Redwood Console (portal-generated PDF + metadata). Portal-created invoices include legal entity name, tax id, and structured metadata for PO and invoice number.
- Option B: Redwood sends a vendor-originated PDF from billing@redwood.ai. We can format the header to include legal name and include structured metadata in the PDF XMP.

Default we recommend: portal as canonical source + automated PDF copy to your finance mailbox (finance@brightwood.ai). That gives you an authoritative record and a direct copy for AP ingest.

2) PO validation
- We support two approaches:
  a) API validation: your AP system calls our /validate-po endpoint during invoice creation (real-time).
  b) Batch list: you upload a PO master file (CSV) to our secure onboarding bucket once daily; we pre-validate PO numbers at invoice finalization.
- If a PO fails validation: by default the invoice is moved to a "PO exception" queue and not sent; there's an automated notification to your AP contact and our billing ops.

3) Credit memos / proration
- We can issue individual credit memos tied to the invoice or a consolidated monthly credit memo.
- SLA: standard CM issuance within 14 business days of confirmed discrepancy. If you prefer consolidated CMs, we can produce a monthly statement (CSV + a single PDF CM) on the 5th business day after month close.

4) Delivery channels for invoices and CMs
- Portal (primary): structured JSON + PDF in the console.
- Email copy: PDF attachments to finance@brightwood.ai (can be multiple recipients).
- SFTP / E-invoice: we can push PDFs/CSV to your SFTP or support UBL/Peppol mapping on request (requires schema mapping work).

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm: portal primary + PDF copies to finance@brightwood.ai?
- Confirm PO validation method: API vs daily CSV upload.
- Confirm CM preference: consolidated monthly vs per-invoice.
- If SFTP is required for CMs, share SFTP host + keys or let us send our onboarding form.

Looping Ben and Connor to scope the config work and Marissa to include this in the MAA (mutual action plan).

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Redwood Inference
